message:
test(ci): make the workflow config test check identity, not existence

The workflow-contract class exists to compare two live sources against each
other, because that is the only thing that catches drift between them. The
token test does exactly that. The config test did not — it asserted the
path the workflow passes exists on disk, and stopped there.

So adding a second config file and pointing the workflow at it left every
area, size, and prefix-liveness test green against a config production no
longer reads, while the labeler applied different thresholds and a
different area map on every pull request. The test now asserts the path
the workflow passes is the same file the suite loads.

Also: a missing `--config` flag raised `IndexError: list index out of
range` from the string split, so the failure named a list index rather
than the missing flag. It now fails with a message, like every sibling
case in the class.
